patterns.pattern_regex: ViewObject|ShapeColor|\.ViewObject\.
patterns.root_cause: LLM uses GUI-mode API in headless FreeCADCmd context
patterns.solution: Remove all ViewObject, ShapeColor, and visual property references
patterns.prevention_prompt: CRITICAL: This runs in headless mode (FreeCADCmd.exe). NEVER use obj.ViewObject, obj.ViewObject.ShapeColor, or any visual/display properties. They are None in headless mode and WILL crash.

patterns.pattern_regex: FreeCADGui|import Gui|Gui\.
patterns.root_cause: LLM imports GUI module which doesn't exist in headless mode
patterns.solution: Remove all FreeCADGui/Gui imports and references
patterns.prevention_prompt: NEVER import or use FreeCADGui or Gui module. They do not exist in headless mode.

patterns.pattern_regex: Part\.show|Part\.Show
patterns.root_cause: Part.show() is a GUI function that fails in headless mode
patterns.solution: Use doc.addObject('Part::Feature', name) instead of Part.show()
patterns.prevention_prompt: Do NOT use Part.show(). Instead, add shapes to the document: obj = doc.addObject('Part::Feature', 'Name'); obj.Shape = your_shape

patterns.pattern_regex: ActiveDocument.*None|NoneType.*has no attribute
patterns.root_cause: Script accesses App.ActiveDocument before creating one
patterns.solution: Always create document first: doc = App.newDocument('Name')
patterns.prevention_prompt: Always create the document at the top: doc = App.newDocument('ModelName'). Never rely on App.ActiveDocument being set automatically.

patterns.pattern_regex: fuse.*fuse.*fuse|\.fuse\(.*\.fuse\(
patterns.root_cause: Chaining too many boolean fuse/cut operations causes slowdown or crashes
patterns.solution: Use Part.Compound for non-intersecting shapes, batch fuse operations
patterns.prevention_prompt: AVOID chaining .fuse() calls (e.g. a.fuse(b).fuse(c).fuse(d)...). For non-intersecting shapes use Part.Compound([shapes]). For intersecting shapes, fuse in batches of 5-10.
